import anonymouslibrary.StrictNames
fun use(): StrictNames = object : StrictNames() { override fun name() = 3 }

import anonymouslibrary.AnyName
fun use(): AnyName = object : AnyName() { override fun name() = "x" }

import anonymouslibrary.Lexical
fun <T> use(value: T): Lexical<T> = object : Lexical<T> { override suspend fun value(): T = value }

import anonymouslibrary.UnitSamSink
fun use(): UnitSamSink = UnitSamSink { 1 }
